# matterbridge_matter (Data Source)

The commissioning status of a Matter server node: the controllers (fabrics) that it is paired with, and the pairing codes. The data source only reads.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "matterbridge_matter" "bridge" {}

output "paired_controllers" {
  value = [for f in data.matterbridge_matter.bridge.fabrics : "${f.vendor_name} ${f.label}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) The server node: Matterbridge (the default, bridge mode), or a plugin name in childbridge mode.

### Read-Only

- `advertising` (Boolean) True if the node advertises for commissioning now.
- `commissioned` (Boolean) True if at least one controller is paired.
- `fabrics` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fabrics))
- `manual_pairing_code` (String, Sensitive) The manual pairing code.
- `online` (Boolean) True if the node is online.
- `qr_pairing_code` (String, Sensitive) The QR code content (MT:...).
- `serial_number` (String) The serial number of the node.
- `session_count` (Number) The number of sessions.
- `window_status` (Number) The commissioning window: 0 closed, 1 enhanced window open, 2 basic window open.

<a id="nestedatt--fabrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fabrics`

Read-Only:

- `fabric_id` (String)
- `index` (Number) The fabric index. It identifies the fabric on this node.
- `label` (String) The fabric label, for example the name of the home.
- `node_id` (String) The node ID in the fabric.
- `vendor_id` (Number) The vendor ID of the controller, for example 4937 for Apple Home.
- `vendor_name` (String) For example (AppleHome).
